Path: `backend/dashboard/`  
React **19**, TypeScript, Vite **7**, react-router-dom **7**. No Next.js.

Dev: `npm run dev` → http://127.0.0.1:5173/dashboard/  
The shell is `width: 100%` and the main pane is `max-width: none`, so every page uses the full viewport beside the sidebar. Below 1180px the sidebar becomes a drawer and the page is the full screen width; filters, the portfolio form, and the report template picker have no max-width. Tables scroll inside `.table-wrap`. Social `/social` uses a flush studio (`main.is-social`) so phones + rail occupy the viewport.  
API: same-origin `/api` via Vite proxy → `http://127.0.0.1:8000` (`VITE_API_PROXY` overrides the target; proxy timeout 180s). Production builds use `VITE_API_URL` (default `https://api.hoc.agency/api`). `VITE_SENTRY_DSN` empty disables dashboard Sentry. Injected `navrix.art` / `selnor.fun` fetches and Vite HMR chunk misses are ignored. The report Gemini panel treats a missing font list or a non-array memory payload as empty instead of reading `.length`. The project form lists every portfolio project as a related-project choice, walking pages of 200.  
Build: `tsc --noEmit && vite build` (`vite.config` `base` `/dashboard/`, React Router `basename` `/dashboard`). Production Caddy serves `dashboard/dist` at `/dashboard/` (no Vite preview proxy). Hashed `/dashboard/assets/*` are immutable; a missing JS/CSS file is 404 (never the SPA HTML). `index.html` is not cached so a deploy does not leave the browser on an old `index-*.js` that then lazy-loads deleted chunks. HTML responses also send `Content-Security-Policy` and `Permissions-Policy` (API, Google fonts, Sentry ingest, and PDF frames stay allowed). Hashed assets do not get those headers.

## Auth

`src/auth.tsx` + `src/api.ts`. Login `POST /auth/login`. Token key `hoc-staff-token` in **localStorage**. Dashboard entry requires `user.is_admin` or a staff `role`. `is_admin` without a role is unrestricted. A role limits sidebar routes to its abilities. Canonical URL **https://hoc.agency/dashboard/** (trailing slash). React Router `basename` stays `/dashboard`. On each navigation, if the browser path is exactly `/dashboard`, the shell `history.replaceState`s to `/dashboard/` and keeps the search and hash. Caddy still 308s `/dashboard` to `/dashboard/`. `/staff` 308s straight to `/dashboard/`.

Demo: `admin@example.com` / `password`.

## Routes (`src/App.tsx`)

| Path | Page |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | Overview — one `GET /admin/overview` (counts, `pending_employees`, recent 6). Stats + status donut sit beside the recent table (not stacked full-width). A shared live pulse (`GET /admin/live` every 4s while the tab is visible) refreshes overview/requests/social in place and toasts when a request status changes or a post is published/fails. Nav badges use that pulse, not a 30s overview poll. |
| `/requests` `/requests/:id` | Requests — search (number, title, client) plus filters for status, source, quotation, invoice, and Drive delivery. Payment badges, remaining confirm, **received amount** before confirm (defaults to expected 50%/full/remaining), paid/remaining %, quotation form **payment plan + line quantity** with **USD** unit prices, client receipts only while **awaiting_payment**, Drive folder as a Google Drive link plus **per-file delivery status** to the client bot (وصل / لم يصل بعد / فشل / موافقة الزبون) and **تحديث الإرسال** as fallback (`POST /admin/requests/{id}/poll-drive`; uploads now notify n8n/Laravel immediately). List shows `sent/total` when files exist. Private Telegram (`tg://user?id=`) or WhatsApp (`https://wa.me/`) chat link for the client who approved/rejected. Detail uses a two-column grid (meta/quote + status/QR/receipts) and the main pane fills the page beside the sidebar. When `client_bot_reachable` is false the aside shows **قرار الزبون بعد مكالمة** (approve/reject on a sent quote, revision with what the client said, accept delivery on review) and a **سُجّل يدوياً** list from `manual_decisions`. A ClickUp failure shows a notice and **إعادة إنشاء مهام ClickUp**. |
| `/employees` | Employees — table from local HR rows; php-fpm GET also pulls Odoo (cached 60s); `artisan serve` skips the live pull. Poll 30s. ClickUp members + Odoo status load once. Search plus filters for status, profession, Odoo link, and active. The employee email is the linked ClickUp member email. **إضافة موظف** creates a local row and reuses an Odoo `hr.employee` with the same email, code, or a unique name. If Odoo refuses the create, the row stays and the form shows the error. Add and edit both have optional Telegram username and user id. **مزامنة من أودو** posts `POST /admin/odoo/sync-employees` and never deletes a local employee; an empty or unavailable Odoo list returns 502 and leaves local rows. DELETE unlinks `hr.employee`. An unlinked row shows «غير مربوط»; the form says the code can be sent to the staff bot later. **No join-request card** — pending staff stay in the table |
| `/permissions` | Named roles. The checklist is every `StaffAbility` case (labels from the API). Table modules use view/create/update/delete. Finance, the report assistant, report templates, report pictures and text box, and the Drive storage account are their own checkboxes. Social abilities each get their own page checklist. The password cell has **توليد كلمة مرور**. Admin only |
| `/clients` | Clients + logos + live Odoo quotations/invoices (amount with currency, Damascus date, status chips, company and contact on two lines, invoice remaining under the total). Each client row has **عروض أسعاره** and **فواتيره**, which open those tabs filtered to that client's Odoo partner — GET lists SQL immediately (no full CRM import). Logo uploads accept jpg/jpeg/png/webp/**svg** (`file`+`mimes`, not Laravel `image`, because SVG fails `getimagesize()`). Up to 3 complete Telegram clients missing a lead are created on Odoo team+stage **تلغرام** during that GET. Tabs poll every 30s; **no CRM import/sync button** (Excel import remains). Telegram clients appear after name/phone/company and are pushed to Odoo CRM once email (or «لا يوجد») and company activity are answered; the client form edits **نشاط الشركة** too, so staff can finish a profile when the bot is down. Delete hides the row (soft delete + unlink Odoo); if the same Telegram user messages the bot again they are restored with their requests. Row actions also open that client's reports and a Drive browser: search by name, browse the folder tree, paste a Drive link, or create a folder and assign it immediately. |
| `/reports` | Client list → that client's reports (breadcrumbs, last edited, Draft / Published / Edited-since-publishing status, Word and PDF Drive links, open, delete with confirm, empty state). The Drive folder picker on both lists searches folders by name, browses the tree, accepts a pasted Drive link, and shows the current folder. Choosing a folder or a link only holds it; the folder is created and assigned when the name is filled and Create and use is pressed. Publishing uploads the Word file only. PDF download sends that Word file to `POST /admin/reports/to-pdf`. **New report** opens a template picker (social media report (A4 cover plus six section pages; missing facts stay غير متوفر; letterhead `public/report-templates/hoc-letterhead.png` sits behind every page and the logo and contact bands stay empty), campaign report, meeting minutes, blank, or import a .docx, plus Word files saved with **حفظ كقالب**. Those files are stored by `GET/POST/DELETE /admin/report-templates` and `GET /admin/report-templates/{id}/document` (`ops.report_templates`). The same name replaces the file. A copy still sitting in this browser is uploaded once, then removed from IndexedDB. Opening a saved template downloads a copy into the new report. The four built-in layouts are listed by that GET and still filled in the browser, because they need the client name and date). A text box is a floating rectangle, rounded rectangle, or ellipse the editor can drag and resize. The assistant reads the selected text, one page, or the whole document.; templates are Arabic RTL Word files built in the browser (`components/report/docxTemplate.ts`: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, A4, cover on page 1, header and footer with page X of Y from page 2, brand tables. Pictures come from the side panel in two modes: **التفاف النص** puts the picture behind the text on every page except the cover, with no page to choose, and **وضع الصورة** puts the picture on its own centred line after the paragraph with the caret, at the chosen width). The editor is `@docx-editor.dev/react` + `core` (Apache-2.0, no key, runs fully in the browser; the paid `pro`/`docx-to-pdf` packages are not used) wrapped by `components/report/ReportDocEditor.tsx`, lazy-loaded (~1 MB gzip chunk). Word-style menus, toolbar, rulers, navigation/find, page setup, headers/footers, tables, images, lists, styles, print. Gotchas: the host box must be `dir="ltr"` (the engine positions RTL words itself); fonts come from `public/fonts` via `customFonts` (Plex registered under Arial/Tahoma/Calibri/Times/Simplified Arabic… so Arabic measures correctly); `setHarfBuzzWasmUrl` points at the Vite-emitted wasm; Arabic chrome strings are in `editorArabic.ts` (missing keys fall back to English); the Report-issue menu row is removed. Insert › صفحة جديدة / New page adds a blank page after the caret (a page break, an empty paragraph, and a second break only when more content follows) via `addBlankPage` in `pageObjects.ts`. Hovering a table shows a corner handle; clicking it selects the whole table and opens **تخطيط الجدول / Table Layout** beside Review (`TableLayoutChrome.tsx`): select table/row/column, insert and delete rows and columns, delete the table, merge and split, borders (scope, style, weight, color), cell fill, vertical alignment, table alignment, width, and header row. Distribute, autofit, and the properties dialog appear when the editor accepts those commands. The tab stays while the caret is in that table. Publishing renders the PDF and uploads it with the Word file into the current folder. The same capture (`report/pdf.ts`: html-to-image per page → pdf-lib) also powers the local download and File › Export PDF / Print. **Autosave** like Word: 1.5 s after the last edit (at least every 15 s while typing, retried every 8 s on failure, immediately when the tab is hidden) the .docx is written to IndexedDB (`report/draftStore.ts`) and then to the server; the title-bar status reads Saving… / All changes saved / Could not save. An untouched template creates nothing; the first edit creates the report and swaps the address to `/reports/{id}/edit` with `history.replaceState` (pages are keyed by pathname in `App.tsx`, so a router navigate would remount the editor). Back and in-app navigation save first (the unmount flush reads the document in a layout-effect cleanup, before the editor unmounts). On open, a local draft whose `base` equals the server `updated_at` (the save never arrived) is restored and saved. Autosave waits for `ReportDocHandle.ready()` so it never stores an empty document. Save (Ctrl+S) saves now; **Publish to Drive** also renders and uploads the PDF. The Drive storage account card is not on this page. Side panel (bottom sheet under 1100px): Gemini shows the previous text beside the new text and applies only if staff confirm; new writing asks for a page. Pictures insert from the same panel (omitted from the plain-text extract), or are generated with Gemini (`POST /admin/reports/gemini-image`). A picture placed in the page is inserted at the caret, then `setImageWrapType` applies Word wrap (square, tight, through, top and bottom, square left or right, behind, in front, or in line) without reloading, so the words stay beside it. **خلف كل الصفحات** still uses `pictureLayout.ts` to add one page-sized `behindDoc` picture to the ordinary header (cropped to cover, never stretched) on every page except the cover. Selecting the picture uses the editor's own wrap, rotate, and properties controls. Arabic labels for those, and for table borders, are in `editorArabic.ts`. The panel also adds a **cover** (a new page 1 with the chosen picture behind it, title/client/date as ordinary editable lines, `titlePg` so it has no header or footer), a **text box** (a one-cell table after the caret's paragraph, borderless or bordered, typed in directly) and **shapes** (rectangle, rounded rectangle as `custGeom`, circle, and a line drawn as a 2.5pt bar), all via `components/report/pageObjects.ts`. The editor (2.22 and 2.23) cannot put a caret inside a floating text box or select/move a `wps` shape, and paints only `rect`/`ellipse`/`line` presets plus `custGeom`, so shapes are placed from the panel (between lines = inline in a centred paragraph; behind text = anchored) and **Remove the last shape** deletes the newest `HOC Shape n`. That generation can take a source picture to raise quality or make a similar picture. The Gemini request can also attach a picture (resized JPEG) so the edit sees it. Gemini text keeps blank lines and numbered lists. A ttf/otf upload is stored in this browser (IndexedDB) and added as a paragraph style (`HocFont…`, `qFormat`) so it shows in the report styles and the font list; the editor remounts from the saved bytes because font config is fixed for one mount. The editor image button moves the caret into the body first; `invalid-range` is explained in Arabic. Attachments, report info/downloads/Drive folder/delete. The browser leave warning shows only while a save is pending. The studio fills the viewport (`.main:has(.report-studio)`). Requires `ops.reports`. The assistant (`ops.report_gemini`), named templates and حفظ كقالب (`ops.report_templates`), pictures and the text box (`ops.report_media`), each have their own checkbox. `ops.drive` stays on the permissions page; the storage card is not shown. A blank document and a Word import stay with report create. |

Social nav gated by abilities (`social.content`, `social.approve`, `social.engage`, `social.messages`, `social.accounts`, `social.links`). The accounts page no longer edits the old four-checkbox matrix; it links admins to `/permissions`. Entering `/social` loads `GET /admin/social/accounts` once (`SocialWorkspace`); inner tabs reuse that list. The picker shows pages, not every network row. Home is an immersive phone studio: dock checks which linked networks to show and publish; Story / Reels / Post sit under the icons (Reels only if Instagram is checked). Instagram and Threads phones follow the landing social layout. Change-page sits in the chrome. Calendar/inbox/links filter by the focused network on that page.

i18n: `src/i18n.ts` (ar/en). `index.html` boots `lang`/`dir` from `hoc-dash-locale` (default Arabic RTL) before React; `readLocale`/`applyLocale` are localStorage-safe. Telegram staff bot link: `VITE_TELEGRAM_STAFF_BOT`.

Request detail shows the current Sham Cash QR thumb and links to `/payments` to replace it. Client receipts and re-request appear only in `awaiting_payment`. The Drive folder is a `drive.google.com` link to the **request leaf** (`HOC Clients / company / package / this request`), or the Hoc Client parent while missing. **إنشاء مجلد Drive** is always shown until the request folder exists; creating the request (catalog or manual) and confirming payment also create that tree immediately. The Google service account JSON is **not** uploaded from the dashboard. The API loads `storage/app/private/google-sa.json` even when `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` points at a missing path. Deploy writes that file from GitHub secret `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64`; `deploy/push.ps1` scp’s the local copy (rsync excludes `storage/app/`). After a quotation approve/reject, sales get a `tg://user?id=` or `https://wa.me/` private chat link (dashboard + staff notify). Writes from the dashboard push to Odoo immediately. **Clients** GET stays SQL-fast; complete Telegram rows missing `odoo_lead_id` create or reuse an opportunity on the existing sales team **تلغرام** and stage **تلغرام** (no second team). Deploy restarts the scheduler and runs `odoo:reconcile` so missing cards land without re-adding the client. Telegram stubs without a complete profile stay hidden and are not pushed. A client keeps one `odoo_partner_id`; quotations reuse it instead of creating a new partner. Person names are not overwritten by the partner/company label. Quotation/invoice tabs read Odoo live and refresh every 15s; request detail hydrates quotation/invoice ids, amounts, and live state from Odoo and refreshes every 15s. POST/PUT/DELETE clients push partner + lead the same way. **Employees** on php-fpm GET pull `hr.employee` (60s cache) and prune locals missing from a complete list; `artisan serve` reads SQL only so nav/overview stay fast. Confirm payment stays here: staff review the receipt, enter the amount actually received, then the API marks the request **مدفوع**, calculates paid/remaining %, posts the Odoo invoice, registers the payment, and sends the invoice PDF. Sales can confirm the same amount from the staff-bot **تأكيد الدفع** button. Request detail shows `work_plan` (department, assignee, priority, hours) when the payment-stage planner has run. Opening a request that is already paid locally also posts/pays a leftover Odoo draft. After confirm, cached package/manual work plans skip a second large Gemini review and provision ClickUp with assignees/due/priority; Gemini still classifies title/description when no plan exists (failure does not keep the request on بانتظار الدفع); English briefs are translated to Arabic with Google Translate before ClickUp.

## Do not assume

This is not the marketing site and not Filament. Clients do not use this SPA.
